map.番茄钟计时器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Pomodoro Timer — an online tool built for developers. It runs entirely on the front end, so your code never leaves the browser.
map.番茄工作法计时器：专注与休息交替。: A Pomodoro Technique timer: alternating focus and rest.
map.：专注 25 分钟 + 短休 5 分钟，每完成 4 个番茄后长休 15–30 分: : focus for 25 minutes plus a 5-minute short break, with a 15–30 minute long break after every 4 pomodoros.
map.：固定时间盒降低开始任务的心理阻力，并强制休息以避免持续疲劳。: : a fixed time box lowers the psychological barrier to starting a task and enforces breaks to avoid sustained fatigue.
map.：应以时间戳差值计算剩余时间，而非累加计时，避免长时间运行产生漂移。: : remaining time should be computed from a timestamp difference rather than accumulated ticks, to avoid drift during long runs.
map.：浏览器会节流后台标签页的定时器，切走时可能出现计时偏差。: : browsers throttle timers in background tabs, so switching away can cause timing inaccuracy.
map.还没有记录，开始第一个番茄吧！: No records yet — start your first pomodoro!

map.给深度工作排节奏：用一个番茄钟屏蔽干扰开始写方案或读文档，时间到再统一处理消息。: Pace deep work: use one pomodoro to shut out distractions and start writing or reading, then handle messages together when the timer ends.
map.专注 25:00 → 休息 05:00，每 4 轮长休 15–30 分。: Focus 25:00 → break 05:00, with a 15–30 minute long break every 4 rounds.
map.可按需调整，核心是专注/休息交替。: It can be adjusted as needed; the point is alternating focus and rest.
map.被打断了要不要重来？: Should I restart after an interruption?
map.视情况而定：如果只是短暂干扰（记下一句话就回来），继续计时即可，把待办记下来稍后: It depends. If the interruption is brief (you jot a note and come back), just keep the timer running and note the task for later. If you are pulled into something else for more than a few minutes, the pomodoro should be abandoned and restarted, because getting back into a focused state takes time on its own. Frequent interruptions mean that slot is not suited to deep work — switch to communication-type tasks instead.
